primary_selection_reason: On exposed first19, sparse recovers 34/43 original-universe Critic reference edges vs hybrid 28/43 and baseline 4/43; source-only runner exactly reproduces original ranks. Selection is development only; no scientific superiority claim.

ranking_policy.sparse: Exact frozen v2 weighted label/alias/definition overlap; score>0; deterministic sorted fsum; no additional synonym or translation generation.
ranking_policy.hybrid: Exact frozen v2 RRF from sparse top20 plus original dense label/context ranks; no new embedding inference.
ranking_policy.cap: Per case per scope, cap equals number of distinct originally retained pool keys; report realized counts separately. Original dense label/context k20 per original scope and k12 in FoodOn typed extension. No additional target universe.
ranking_policy.unknown: No source identity/qualifier evidence is invented; no positive sparse score implies no sparse candidate. Preserve empty groups and untranslated residue; do not fill with fabricated mappings.
ranking_policy.risk_tail: A1_RISK_TAIL and P2_CONDITIONAL remain exposed-development diagnostics, not frozen generalizable retrieval methods. They do not alter membership or grant review permission.

metrics.primary: Original-universe per-case Reference-Hit@12 among cases with at least one independently reviewed supported in-universe target; K per scope, not global. Compare paired arms.
secondary: Supported reference-edge overlap in retained pool
Negative overlap at each K and pool
Source lexical coverage and untranslated residue; missing source evidence remains unknown
metrics.support_definition: Use original compare_reference.supported: EXACT, CLOSE, BROADER_TARGET, NARROWER_TARGET, RELATED, CONDITIONAL with applicability not UNRESOLVED. Separate FoodOn extension domain; no reference denominator implies NA.
metrics.interpretation: Critic reference overlap, not scientific recall/precision. No formal error tolerance or sample power assumed. Report denominators, paired results, limitations and all arms; no winner declaration based on independent-set tuning.

steps: Controller verifies frozen reserved32 source packet byte identity and source rights; prepare exact retrieval projection after authorization, without reading review outcomes. Reviewer's allowed packet contains source facts and fixed standards only, not dense hints or candidate ranks.
Execute frozen retrieval and pin output bytes before independent reviewer response exposure.
Use an independent source-first reviewer with documented model identity, prior exposure, allowed file list and actual access controls. No expert qualification claim from AI.

Validate native target identity, version, label, exact source locator, and support/negative judgment; FNDDS single-carrier locator exception only by explicit controller same-cycle addendum, never alter reviewer bytes.
After frozen response and explicit authorized comparison, evaluate all predeclared arms and metrics. Do not revise lexicon, scoring, thresholds, caps or universe using reserved32.

If retrieval signal absent or hard negatives/unknown qualifiers remain consequential, preserve HOLD and develop native regional concepts or a new independent development cohort. No C3/B3, mapping release, or nutrient transfer from this study.
reserved32_protocol.limits: 72 source-derived dev lexical entries may have poor coverage on unseen records; the experiment measures that limitation. Generic retrieval runner tested on first19 only; reserved32 controller projection and verified review/score run not performed. Local process-level field allowlist is not independent OS ACL proof.
